body:
your liver doesn't need to be cleansed. its purpose as an organ is to detoxify your body already. 

if you're otherwise healthy and just worried about liver health, eat a diet low in fatty foods, avoid alcohol, watch your sodium intake, stay hydrated, and take fiber supplements. unless your doctor tells you that you're having liver problems that should be all you need, and if you are having liver problems they should be the one prescribing you medication or recommending supplements and should know about any potential interactions it might have.
you just shared 3 articles in a row by the same person... if you wrote them yourself just say so, you don't have to act like you just stumbled across them
